description: This file defines the ProductOptionEntity class, which extends ProductOption and implements Serializable. It adds properties such as order, code, and type with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ProductOptionEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing a product option entity with additional attributes like order, code, and type, extending ProductOption.
